technical-summary: LTX03: model-backed three-rank declarations for the video and audio FFN (up row-sharded, down column-sharded), modulation and gated-residual operations across all 48 DiT blocks and both legal head maps, with the exact three-rank reduction for biasless video outputs and the once-only bf16 bias for audio outputs. Host-only native CTest 14/14 and the managed patch replays idempotently; no GPU run.
